record.original_question: For the Riemann zeta function zeta(s), the Apéry constant is zeta(3), and it is known to be irrational. Is zeta(3) transcendental? More generally, for every natural number k, are the odd zeta values zeta(2k+1) irrational or transcendental?

evidence.quote: For the Riemann zeta function ζ(s), the value of ζ(3) is well known as the Apéry constant and it is an irrational number. The question about Apéry constant being transcendental is an open problem. Further, the values of ζ(2k+1), for all k in N, being irrational or transcendental also remains unsolved.

artifact.category_tag: Irrationality and transcendence of zeta values
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\zeta(s)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n^{-s}$ denote the Riemann zeta function, defined for $\operatorname{Re}(s)>1$ and extended by analytic continuation. The value $\zeta(3)$ is known as Apéry's constant, and Apéry (1978) proved that $\zeta(3)$ is irrational.

(a) Determine whether $\zeta(3)$ is transcendental over $\mathbb{Q}$.

(b) More generally, for every positive integer $k$, determine whether the odd zeta value $\zeta(2k+1)$ is irrational, and whether it is transcendental over $\mathbb{Q}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The transcendence of ζ(3) and the irrationality/transcendence of ζ(2k+1) for general k≥2 remain open problems. Partial results are known: Rivoal (2000) proved that infinitely many of the values ζ(2k+1) are irrational, and Zudilin (2001) showed that at least one of ζ(5), ζ(7), ζ(9), ζ(11) is irrational. No individual ζ(2k+1) for k≥2 is known to be irrational, and transcendence of ζ(3) is unproved.

status_evidence.title: Irrationality of values of the Riemann zeta function (Rivoal)
status_evidence.snippet: Rivoal proved that infinitely many of the numbers ζ(2k+1) are irrational.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial irrationality results are known for odd zeta values.

status_evidence.title: One of the numbers ζ(5), ζ(7), ζ(9), ζ(11) is irrational (Zudilin)
status_evidence.snippet: At least one of the four numbers ζ(5), ζ(7), ζ(9), ζ(11) is irrational.
status_evidence.claim: No individual odd zeta value beyond ζ(3) is known to be irrational.
